description.fallback: Having sustained a powerful blow to the head, DIO is momentarily dazed. Although he still appears confident, this confidence begins to deteriorate when he discovers the trauma has left him incapable of walking or moving properly because of the brain damage, which also slows his healing factor. Meanwhile, Jotaro retrieves a nearby bucket and punches a hole in the fuel tank of a car to fill it up with gasoline.
